description:
Night At Derinkuyu

v0.3.2

Direct Download for 0.98a-RC8

GitHub Releases and Changelog

Night At Derinkuyu is intended to be a story-oriented mod focusing on the relatively unimportant Derinkuyu Mining Station. This mod currently adds two vaguely related short quests with at least over 15,000 words of text, and an independent underworld contact with partially custom dialogue for vanilla underworld contact missions to the campaign.

Story Examples (Spoilers!)
The two quests this mod has can be found at most bars from game start.
"The Derinkuyu Drop"
Just a simple dead drop with fun dialogue and an extra complication.
There's a moment of bated breath as a miniaturized stealth relay unfolds itself, sliding out of the now unshielded crate. You watch the display feed as maneuvering thrusters softly glide the relay away from your flagship, and into space.

The image flickers, warbles, shakes... then nothing.

Your sensors officer looks up, a thin sheen of sweat on their forehead. "Captain, we've lost the nav. It's gone."

> Continue

There's a sense of déjà vu as crew chatter quietly over comms, incredulous. Was that it? Just a souped-up civilian relay made for military-spec adventures? No trigger-happy fleets coming to claim the lives of your crew any more than usual?

"There were rumours," your sensors officer mumbles aloud to themselves. "Nobody thought it was worth the risk."

> "Sometimes, rumors are just that. Nothing more."
> "There's something coming our way, isn't there?"
> Continue

"Nothing new on sensors, captain." Your crew exchange glances as your sensors officer double-checks their work. "I can't see any reason for concern at the moment, but..."

"Finding The Luminary"
Someone really wants their Apogee, and they're paying you extra to get it back.
The shuttle flight begins as every other one you've ever had. Your shuttle pilot makes routine chatter with traffic control, who today are surprisingly more professional than you expect them being. For pirates.

"Yeah, 'kay. To the docking bays, is it? What's the purpose of your shuttle flight today?"

Your shuttle pilot wordlessly passes over comms control to your datapad for you to respond.

> "To see that attraction everyone's talking about."
> "Business."
> Wordlessly pass comms control back to the pilot

You hear your shuttle pilot sigh. "Captain would like to visit the new attraction today."

"Oh, a chauffeur, I see. Long day?"

There's a muffled grunt of acknowledgement from your pilot.

"I feel ya. Routing you now, docking bay 3, attached shuttle bay 18. Courtesy of the portboss," they tack on hastily.

Reflavoured Vanilla Quests
Completing "The Derinkuyu Drop" unlocks an independent underworld contact with partially new dialogue for most vanilla underworld contact quests.
> Ask about taking on one of the bounty jobs

"Let's put it like this. You don't normally think about the influence of the independents in the Persean Sector, right?" He gestures at a softly glowing ad-holo playing theatrically behind him, punctuating his every sentence with exaggerated sound effects and visual cues. "After all, the big players are folk like the Hegemony. And you'd be right, all the way 'til you came down to comms me. Why? Because you're about to go blow up the little toys of the big players!"

"League patrol in the pocket of rogues? Hegemony inspector too overzealous in their search? Church patrol trying to confiscate perfectly legal scientific equipment? That's when people start calling on us, to start reminding them that the spacers of the sector can be just every bit as ruthless as the pirates they claim to protect us from."

"...well, not that I necessarily believe all that, but we'll get paid well either way. Just like I got paid to say all that," he adds with a sardonic laugh, flicking the ad-holo off with a dismissive gesture.

May contain bugs! Please report them if you see them.

Should be good to add to existing saves, but probably not to remove from saves.

Many thanks to the many modders who have quest stuff in their mods.
